objective: Replace the name-based deny/scan approach to an external development-methodology plugin with Chohogi-native organs that perform each of its functions, so the capability is carried by Chohogi's own contracts instead of being blocked.
requested: remove the deny rules and the name-marker scanner added in this session
map every skill of the external methodology plugin to the Chohogi organ that owns that function
rebuild missing functions in Chohogi's own structure and vocabulary, not by copying source
record attribution only in the provenance ledger
excluded: copying the external plugin's text, file layout, or skill names into active Chohogi assets
making the external plugin a runtime dependency or controller
editing the user's private ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md without explicit approval

requestedItems.description: Remove deny paragraphs in AGENTS.md and capability-selection.md and the retired-capability marker scanner with its manifest, registry, README, and test consumers.
Map each of the 15 external skills to an existing or new Chohogi organ with a covered/partial/missing verdict backed by file evidence.
Implement the missing and partial functions inside the owning Chohogi organ using Chohogi vocabulary.
Keep origin naming only in xylem_provenance/provenance.json.

acceptance.description: No active asset carries a name-based deny rule or name-marker gate for the external plugin.
Semantic, functional-assurance, provenance, document-registry, source-layout, skills verifiers and the unittest suite pass after the change.
